title: Seeing this  @Hell’s Kitchen on Broadway clip FLOORED ME! More of thi...
transcript: That is the official Hell's Kitchen on Broadway account posting footage of the show. I legit thought I was scrolling by a bootleg. I cannot express how happy that clip makes me. Not only because Jessica Vasquez is fucking singing the shit get out of that song, but like, this is what people want. We wanna see clips of the show. And I just love this clip because it looks like how you see it in the theatre. It doesn't look like overly polished B roll. I don't need that. I just. I wanna see the experience that I'm gonna be getting sitting in my one seat in the theatre. It is literally this easy. Like, Hell's Kitchen is a show that I don't even personally love, and that clip has me going, wow, I kinda wish I'd went to go see Jessica Vosk in Hell's Kitchen. I mean, really, my only note is that we're seeing Jessica Vosk on, unfortunately, her last performance. And like, half of the comments are like, wow, I didn't know this was happening. I really wanna buy tickets to the show, but she's not in it anymore. But I absolutely love this and I hope more shows keep doing this. Just absolutely. Chef's kiss.
